posts.title: Introduction to Formal Methods (Part 2): From Spec to Code
posts.description: In Part 1, we talked about the “Why”. Why write a spec? Because English is ambiguous, and debugging design flaws in code is expensive. We looked at Quint and modeled a simple TCP Handshake. We verified that our logic was sound (no safety violations).
